_comment: Advisories that `npm audit --audit-level=high` may report without failing CI. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD); after expiry the advisory fails the security job again. Remove entries as soon as the dependency is fixed. Checked by scripts/npm-audit-gate.sh.

advisories.reason: postcss 8.4.31 is pinned inside next 15 and runs only at build time on first-party CSS in site/; the file read needs an attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL in processed CSS. Fix: an npm override to postcss >= 8.5.30 in site/package.json.
Same build-time-only postcss copy as GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q; path traversal needs attacker-controlled CSS input.
